extraction_scope: worker-6 source-reviewed final mechanism adjudication from XML/PDF sections and OA figures; no single receptor/protein target is inferred.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: EC1-17KV damages bacterial membrane integrity with direct permeability, ultrastructure, liposome leakage, Ca2+/LPS-release, and Ca2+/EDTA modulation evidence.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Supports membrane disruption and divalent-cation/LPS interaction context; does not prove a single protein receptor.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: EC1-17KV disrupts C. albicans membrane integrity and fluidity, with binding, PI uptake, TEM morphology, K+ leakage, and TMA-DPH membrane-fluidity evidence.
direct_assay_types: zeta potential and FITC-labelled peptide binding
mechanism_claims.limitations: Ergosterol gene-expression results were reported as not explaining the effect; mechanism is membrane perturbation rather than ergosterol-synthesis inhibition.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: EC1-17KV reduces P. aeruginosa biofilm formation/preformed-biofilm burden in vitro and catheter biofilm burden in vivo.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: EC1-17KV against P. aeruginosa biofilm models
mechanism_claims.limitations: Biofilm phenotype is source-supported; exact database inhibition percentage remains figure-only and is not promoted to a precise final activity value.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: EC1-17KV inhibits C. albicans adhesion, hyphal switching, biofilm formation, and EPS accumulation, including downregulation of hypha-related genes in the source assays.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: EC1-17KV against C. albicans adhesion/hypha/biofilm models
mechanism_claims.limitations: Antibiofilm and hyphal phenotypes are source-supported; they are not converted into a single molecular target claim.
